messages:
mike: Heads-up — found a 403 on an asset linked from /kb/getting-started (the 'rapid-batching' tutorial zip). The file at https://s3.redwood.ai/rapid-batching.zip returns 403 for me. Anyone owning that page?

elaine: I thought devex maintained the onboarding KB. Ping @sam for docs owner? This doc is surfaced in the new-hire flow so would like a quick patch.

sam: I can take this. Where exactly in the repo is the doc? Also FYI the 'rapid-batching' feature was sunset last quarter — recommend we remove the zip and point to the batching guide instead. I'll prepare a tiny PR.

tia: Confirmed — rapid-batching was deprecated in Nov. Suggestion: add a deprecation note + redirect the old zip URL to /kb/batching-config, then replace the external asset with inline steps (fewer moving parts).

docs-bot: link-scan: flagged https://s3.redwood.ai/rapid-batching.zip -> 403 on 2026-02-28; severity: low; file: /kb/getting-started.md

sam: Drafted patch — replacing the external zip with an inline callout. Quick diff preview:

```
- Download the rapid-batching tutorial: [rapid-batching.zip](https://s3.redwood.ai/rapid-batching.zip)
+ Note: "rapid-batching" was deprecated. See the batching guide: /kb/batching-config
+ Inline steps:
+ 1. Update your config: `batch_size: 64`
+ 2. Enable prefix caching: `cache_prefix: true`
```

PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330 — small text + redirect rule. @elaine can you review?

elaine: Looking now, will review within the hour. If it's tiny we can ship in tomorrow morning deploy window.

tia: Confirmed — I added a CDN redirect rule for the old zip -> /kb/batching-config; propagation should be ~10m. I'll also add the deprecation note to the batching guide.

mike: Awesome, thanks all. Marking this as done on my side once PR merges. Please add a one-line changelog note so onboarding folks know the asset is removed. :thumbsup:
